name: Boundaries (Oracle Mystery)
body:
You enjoy the freedom to cross from one area to the next effortlessly. This crossing may be as mundane as through a locked door or as complex as a journey from one plane to another.

Authorities might call on you to guard the city gates or those who have lost a loved one might beseech you to serve as an intermediary between the living and the dead.

Class Skills: An oracle with the boundaries mystery adds Disable Device, Knowledge (nature), Perception, and Survival to her list of class skills.

Bonus Spells: hold portal (2nd), knock (4th), discovery torch (6th), dimension door (8th), passwall (10th), find the path (12th), greater teleport (14th), wall of lava (16th), gate (18th).

Revelations

An oracle with the boundaries mystery can choose from any of the following revelations. If you are using the Core Classes from the Amazons vs Valkyries rules, these Revelations can replace the standard abilities that priestesses gain at 2nd, 4th, 6th, 8th, and 10th level.

Border Patrol (Su)

You automatically know when a creature is of the outsider type.

Whenever you make a successful attack against a creature with the outsider type, you deal an additional amount of damage equal to your Charisma modifier. You do not deal this extra damage to outsiders with the native subtype.

Burrow

When you can’t go through a barrier, you often go under it! You gain a burrow speed of 20 feet.

Bypass Protection (Su)

Your weapon attacks are treated as magical for the purpose of overcoming damage reduction. At 11th level, your weapons are considered to be silver, and at 15th level, they are considered to be adamantine. You must be at least 3rd level to select this revelation.

Circumvent Locks and Traps (Ex)

You add half of your oracle level to Disable Device checks and you can use Disable Device to disable magical traps.

Create Portal (Su)

As a swift action, you create a rip in the fabric of reality and step through it. The rip immediately seals behind you and removes you from time for 1 round. During this period, you can cast a spell upon yourself or your possessions, use a magic item, or make a Heal check upon yourself. At the start of your next turn, you must use a swift action to open the portal (in any empty square within 60 feet of where you first created the portal) and exit it. (If you fall unconscious while in the portal, it automatically deposits you back in your original space at the start of your next turn.) You can use this ability once per day and one additional time per day at 15th level. You must be at least 11th level to select this revelation.

Crossing Borders: You learn a number of additional languages equal to your Charisma modifier when you select this revelation. At 7th level, you can cast speak with dead as a spell-like ability once per day.

Light the Way (Ex and Sp)

You gain low-light vision. Additionally, as a standard action, you can summon a torch or a round sphere of light that resembles a moon to hover by your shoulder. Both options shed light as a torch and can be dismissed as a swift action. (There is no limit to how many times a day you can use this revelation.)

Personal Space (Su)

As a standard action, you create a bubble of force around yourself that repels attacks, granting you a +1 deflection bonus to your armor class. At 7th level, and every four levels thereafter, this bonus increases by +1. While this revelation is active, you gain damage reduction 10/magic against ranged weapon attacks. You can use this revelation for 1 hour per day per oracle level you possess. This duration does not need to be consecutive, but it must be spent in 1-hour increments.

Unbound (Sp)

You can cast burst bonds as a spell-like ability once per day. At 7th level, anytime you roll a saving throw against the entangled condition, you roll two dice and use the better roll. Furthermore, you do not need to make a concentration check to cast a spell when you are entangled.

Watchdog (Su)

You’ve gained the companionship of an invisible, intangible, spirit watchdog that looks over you and alerts you to danger with sharp barks that only you can hear.

The watchdog always shares your space and can’t be harmed by any means. You gain a +2 circumstance bonus on initiative rolls. At 3rd level, as soon as you go to sleep, your watch dog immediately falls under the effects of the alarm spell. Your watchdog is the point at which the spell is centered upon and the alarm type is barking that only you can hear in your mind. At 7th level, you can’t be surprised.

Final Revelation

Upon reaching 20th level, you can straddle the boundary between life and death. As a standard action, you can gain the Incorporeal (Ex) monster trait. You can remain incorporeal for up to 1 hour per day. You can break this time up into 10-minute increments.

Additionally, once per day, when you are close to death, you can reach for the side of life.

When you take damage that would reduce you to one-quarter or less of your hit points, but not kill you outright, you can use an immediate action to heal 10d8 hit points.
